_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 9-16 October 2025: the Economist cover, Romania, the ten cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are not allowed to say certain things and can get a two year sentence for preaching, and points to killings in Nigeria and Iran as part of a great escalation.
mentions.quote: You cannot even preach to people and they will give you a 2-year sentence
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a description of current persecution.

mentions.claim_text: Told the live count is 5,400, he says the Lord said to assemble themselves together and pray, each one bringing their part.
mentions.quote: you have to go assemble yourself together and pray
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction. The live count of 5,400 is a measurable audience figure, close to the 5,500 he gives twelve days later.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has been asked to come to a prayer conference in Branson, Missouri and has agreed, though he does not know what he will do there.
mentions.quote: her prayer conference in Branson City, Missouri
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: travel plans. Recorded because Branson is the town he names four days later for a great revival.

mentions.claim_text: He says the event is at her property with a fish fry and that he is still praying about whether to go.
mentions.quote: she is asking me to come to that and I am still praying about that
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: travel plans.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard the Lord say in his tongues that Jesus is coming, and asks whether hearers really understand it.
mentions.quote: Brandon, I am coming
mentions.falsify_match: The return occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a 2019 Economist cover and says the mischief panda with folded arms is what he was shown concerning China.
mentions.quote: concerning China with that mischief panda
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a magazine cover from 2019 read as confirmation of a later vision.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. Recorded because reading published artwork as confirmation is a recurring method here.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the Ukraine war had not started when the cover was published, and says Pinocchio on it is Zelenskyy, whom he had already identified.
mentions.quote: Pinocchio. I have already told you who Pinocchio was
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: an identification of a figure on a 2019 magazine cover.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not giving the magazine credibility or mixing the prophetic with the world, but that he has seen it by the Spirit and the Lord told him to go and look.
mentions.quote: I am not trying to mix prophetic with this world
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a disclaimer about method, which is worth keeping because the method is exactly what he is doing.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Spirit has been warning through prayer while they talk through magazines, and that he saw the panda though he does not know what to make of it.
mentions.quote: they try to talk through magazines and stuff
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: he says he does not know.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a shaking of their economy with all the fingers pointing at him, and that he then turned his face toward Taiwan.
mentions.quote: he started eyeing Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: A Chinese economic crisis followed by a move on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The sequence, crisis then diversion, is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw someone used to help with troops and things to back the movement, not because they wanted to but because they had to.
mentions.quote: Not that they wanted to but they had to
mentions.falsify_match: A reluctant troop contribution to a coalition.

mentions.claim_text: He says Putin is upset because the president is saying he wants to give Ukraine the missiles he was shown, confirming that a certain one does get into it.
mentions.quote: he wants to give Ukraine those missiles that I was shown
mentions.falsify_match: Long range missiles transferred to Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: None transferred. Tomahawk transfer was in the news that week, which is where the framing comes from.

mentions.claim_text: He asks about the F-16s and says there is more about escalation of war, placing the battleship he saw out by Venezuela.
mentions.quote: This battleship was out by Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: American warships deployed off Venezuela. This had already begun in August 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He describes men going to war in snowsuits and old fur hats, and reports the Lord saying to watch Romania because Romania will be involved, and to watch Poland and Ukraine.
mentions.quote: Watch Romania because Romania will be involved
mentions.falsify_match: Romania drawn into the war alongside Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Romania named specifically is the checkable addition.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to pray for America over the enemy within, homegrown terrorists and lone wolves, and to pray for the president.
mentions.quote: about the enemy within our nation, about our lone wolves
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction to pray over a standing threat category.

mentions.claim_text: He says if too much is reserved for self God cannot move because he is in the way, and asks to stay on the potter wheel.
mentions.quote: if there is too much reserved for self and he cannot move
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: self-examination.

mentions.claim_text: He gives the Branson conference schedule as Wednesday through Sunday and says he is not promised for the whole thing.
mentions.quote: The first service starts Wednesday and it goes Wednesday, Thursday
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a published conference schedule.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were praying for the Canadian prime minister, whose surname he has to be given, and for the revival that will come there.
mentions.quote: We were praying for that man
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition, with the name supplied to him in the room.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told them they would see a major revival as people reached righteous indignation, and that he saw the church rise up like a giant with a backbone.
mentions.quote: I saw the church rise up like a giant with a backbone
mentions.falsify_match: A visible church mobilisation in Canada.

mentions.claim_text: He says the figure knew Adam lease was coming up and began slithering like a snake throughout Europe, speaking to the Pope and creating something.
mentions.quote: he started slithering like a snake all throughout Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: activity in the spirit realm with no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He says the number is up to nine and they do not know who came across, and reports being told to pray into the ten major cities he was shown and the antisemitic uprising.
mentions.quote: Pray into these major cities that I have showed you about the 10
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks across ten American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The count moves from nine to ten inside the passage, and the cities are not listed here.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch the fig tree, that they are at the end of the end, and that he saw a storm on all fronts in the days ahead when Ezekiel 38 and 39 come.
mentions.quote: I saw a storm on all fronts in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: The Ezekiel coalition war beginning.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the talk of de-escalating Gaza, returning hostages and signing agreements, and says what he has seen in the spirit is otherwise.
mentions.quote: we are going to de-escalate Gaza and get the hostages back
mentions.falsify_match: The Gaza agreement failing despite the announcements.
mentions.falsify_miss: It holds. Given three days after the ceasefire took effect.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects himself from Israel to Syria and says they will be brothers, because they did not care that Iran was struck but when Syria is struck they will all come to its defence.
mentions.quote: when Syria is messed with in the days ahead, they will all come
mentions.falsify_match: Arab states intervening for Syria after ignoring strikes on Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. The contrast between the two cases is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Arabs rise up very upset, that he saw ground invasions with the red hats and an uprising, and that this is where he told them World War Three, with Turkey beating drums.
mentions.quote: I saw troop ground invasions with the red hats
mentions.falsify_match: Ground invasions by forces in red headgear, with Turkey entering.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The red hats detail recurs from January 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says the hand of God defends Israel and asks where the big brother is, answering that big brother is putting out fires in his own nation, with an uprising of craziness happening there.
mentions.quote: Big brother is putting out fires in his own nation
mentions.falsify_match: America unable to support Israel because of domestic disorder.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is able. The causal link is the checkable part.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is when he saw shaking coming to British Columbia and a major earthquake there, alongside whiskey barrels rolling down in Canada.
mentions.quote: I saw shaking coming to British Columbia. I saw a major earthquake
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake in British Columbia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named province on the Cascadia margin, which is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba rises up into a friendship with Russia recalling the old Cuban missile crisis, and that he warned Cuba will help Russia in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: Cuba will help Russia in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba providing material support to Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He restates that Russia will use a weapon never seen before on Poland, and that it will be a weapon of mass destruction that is not nuclear.
mentions.quote: a weapon of mass destruction that will not be nuclear
mentions.falsify_match: A non-nuclear weapon of mass destruction used against Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: None used. Excluding nuclear is a real narrowing, repeated here from March 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says the puppet is removed and a new proxy government eventually comes into Ukraine, that he saw it, and that their plan was a pro-Ukraine pro-Russian arrangement.
mentions.quote: the puppet is removed. And a new proxy government comes in
mentions.falsify_match: Zelenskyy removed and a proxy government installed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He is not. This is the 9 October telling, a month before the grey-haired man detail.
